rules: Keep technical design separate from product behavior specs.
Discover system boundaries, data ownership and public contracts before architectural changes.
Keep core small and stable; feature-specific behavior belongs in explicit modules.
Keep UI/API/CLI/host adapters at the edge and external IO behind infrastructure adapters.
Prefer a modular monolith/internal module boundary over microservices until independent deployment, scale, fault isolation, data ownership or team ownership justifies a service boundary.
Preserve brownfield architecture unless the active change explicitly requires migration.
